requirement: Submit to BOEM three copies of the modeling report and three sets of digital files as supporting information. The digital files must contain the formatted meteorological files used in the modeling runs, the model input file, and the model output file.
scope: Air quality modeling performed in support of activities proposed in the plan, specifically for the western Gulf of Mexico (west of 87.5° west longitude) and offshore of the North Slope Borough of Alaska.
related_domains: air quality modeling; data submission; regulatory reporting
